title: Lab 02 Report: Data-Driven AI for Requirements Prioritization

sections.title: 1. Baseline Diagnosis
sections.placeholder: Document the support-pressure baseline, selected release, engineer-day usage, and one limitation you observed before using NLP or supervised ML.

sections.title: 2. NLP Evidence Extraction
sections.placeholder: Report the TF-IDF/cosine-similarity threshold you selected, audited matching accuracy, coverage, examples of correct/ambiguous matches, and why the threshold is defensible.

sections.title: 3. Model Selection and Feature Engineering
sections.placeholder: Explain how raw telemetry and NLP-derived feedback were joined into the historical feature schema. Compare Logistic Regression and Random Forest using 5-fold macro-F1 and justify the model you deployed.

sections.title: 4. AI-Assisted Release and Product Impact
sections.placeholder: Present P(SHIPPED_NEXT) for the leading requirements, the dependency-aware 75-day release plan, visible changes in the live product, and verification evidence.

sections.title: 5. Counterfactual / Ablation Analysis
sections.placeholder: Change one realistic assumption or remove one model feature. Re-run the model and release plan. Explain which priorities changed, why, and what this says about robustness and historical bias.

sections.title: 6. Release Recommendation
sections.placeholder: State what you would ship and what additional evidence you would request before committing engineering resources. Distinguish model evidence from the final engineering decision.
